subject: SIG / CAIQ request: tailored retention windows & proof-of-delete evidence for SolsticeAI
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@solstice.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@solstice.ai, priya.raman@solstice.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:09:00 -0800
Subject: Retention & deletion evidence request for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Naomi / Ben —

Thanks for talking with Priya and me last week. As we prepare for our SIG/CAIQ update (internal audit next month) we need a packaged set of artifacts from Redwood that demonstrate how tenant-scoped logs and ephemeral traces are handled. Specifically Solstice AI needs the following:

- A per-log-class retention matrix that maps each log type (request traces, debug traces, KV cache snapshots, audit trails) to Redwood retention policy by tenant and region.
- A sample proof-of-delete workflow (what we would hand back after a SAR or erasure request), with an example certificate/file we can present to auditors.
- Clarification on whether Solstice tenant data in EU regions can be given an exception (we have a concurrent e-discovery hold from a regulator). If exceptions are available, what guardrails (legal hold process, escalation, and audit trail) are required?
- Any CAIQ/SIG mapping rows you can provide that clarify where deletion/retention controls are documented.

We're on a compressed timeline; can you confirm what you can provide by Nov 27 and what will require a security/legal review? Also note we may need redacted logs as evidence for privacy reasons.

Appreciate it —
Liam
Solution Compliance, Solstice AI

--
Attachment: requested-sig-questions.xlsx (stub)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@solstice.ai>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@solstice.ai>, contracts@solstice.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention & deletion evidence request for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a consolidated evidence packet; below is what we will include and what needs an internal sign-off.

What we will provide by Nov 27 (no new compliance exceptions required):
- retention-matrix-v2.csv — per-log class mapping with tenant/regional columns (CSV).
- proof-of-delete-sample.txt — redacted example of the deletion certificate and audit trail we provide after an erasure request.
- sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx — pointers to our CAIQ rows and SIG controls that reference retention and deletion.

What requires a security/legal review before we can confirm (target timeline: 48 business hours back to you):
- Any formal "exception" to standard retention in EU regions while a regulator hold is open. We can support short-term accommodations via an internal legal-hold flow, but that requires Solstice to supply signed legal-hold instructions and tenant IDs.
- Delivery of redacted logs for auditor consumption. We will need a defined scope (log IDs / time ranges) and a privacy review for PII.

Action items for you: please send the list of tenant IDs and the regulatory hold reference (case number) so we can route to Legal and Compliance. If you want, Ben and I can set a 30-minute call to run through the packet and any redaction questions.

I'll attach the artifacts we can deliver now; Kimberly is looped in for the remainder of the evidence.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: retention-matrix-v2.csv (stub), proof-of-delete-sample.txt (stub), sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx (stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:52:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: SolsticeAI evidence packet — items + risk notes

Naomi / Ben —

I reviewed Solstice's ask. Drafting notes and items to include in the packet:

1) Segmented erase playbook (segmented-erase-playbook.pdf) — describes our per-tenant deletion flow, staging window, and certification artifacts. Important: for EU-regulated holds we cannot unilaterally bypass the 30-day remediation staging for forensic snapshotting unless Legal permits an emergency override; we can instead provide a pseudo-anonymized extract within 48 hours.

2) Retention matrix (retention-matrix-v2.csv) — ensure columns: log_class, default_ttl_days, eu_ttl_override, forensic_hold_flag, retention_bucket_id. I recommend adding a "proof_of_delete_token" sample column for auditors.

3) SIG/CAIQ mapping (sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx) — highlight rows A.12, A.15 (data lifecycle) and B.3 (audit logging) with direct doc links.

4) Proof-of-delete sample (proof-of-delete-sample.txt) — redacted; include the hash, deletion timestamp, operator id, and a unique certificate id.

5) Per-tenant delete cert template (per-tenant-delete-cert-template.docx) — internal only; include as internal attachment if Legal requests editing.

Operational asks before we ship:
- Confirm Solstice tenant IDs and the scope/time ranges they need evidence for.
- Confirm whether they require raw log excerpts (PII redaction required) or only the proof artifacts.

I can prepare the packet and run the privacy redaction; give me until COB Nov 26 to get the sanitized samples ready. If Legal wants to permit a temporary EU TTL carveout (for regulator hold), they'll need signed instructions and an approved compensating control list.

-Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments (internal): segmented-erase-playbook.pdf (stub), per-tenant-delete-cert-template.docx (internal stub)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@solstice.ai>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@solstice.ai>, contracts@solstice.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention & deletion evidence request for upcoming SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Liam / Priya —

We prepared an initial evidence packet and uploaded it to the Drive folder linked below. Items included: retention-matrix-v2.csv, proof-of-delete-sample.txt, sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx, and segmented-erase-playbook.pdf (redacted).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D4SolsticeEvidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/SL-98765

Next steps:
- Please confirm the tenant IDs and the regulator hold reference so we can route for Legal approval if you need an exception for EU TTLs.
- If you want raw log excerpts for the auditor, specify the log IDs and time ranges. We will scope redaction and return a sanitized PDF within 48 hours of confirmation.
- I'm happy to set a 30-minute call (availability: Fri 11/27 9–11am PT or Mon 11/30 2–4pm PT).

If that timeline works, Ben will follow up on procurement items (if you need a supplemental NDA or updated SOW for hold handling).

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference
